piece: Queen María of Castile to Alfonso V, register copy
system: Unknown. Three short cipher runs of digit-like, letter-like and figure signs inside a Catalan letter; dotted figures (sq, bp, O) may be nomenclator signs (hypothesis from the 1429 key).
sign_inventory_note: Sign names of cipher.txt: ff, 6, 8 (plain), 8R (8 with top-right stroke), 8L (8 with left tail, only after 6), tri, sq (square hook, dotted), bp (b with bracket, dotted), O (circle with dot, dotted), t, z, a d n v M, 2 3 9, E, E2. No sign is marked N: or 0: because no key exists; the dots flanking sq, bp and O are not tokens.
caveats: About 40 signs in all: far too short for statistics.
